fullPassage: You already have a business and you're about to launch your blog so that you can sell your product. Unfortunately, here is where a 'business mind' can be a bad thing. Most people believe that to have a successful business blog promoting a product, they have to stay strictly 'on the topic.' If all you're doing is shamelessly promoting your product, then who is going to want to read the latest thing you're writing about? Instead, you need to give some useful or entertaining information away for free so that people have a reason to keep coming back. Only by doing this can you create an interested audience that you will then be able to sell to. So, the best way to be successful with a business blog is to write about things that your audience will be interested in.

questions.passage: You already have a business and you're about to launch your blog so that you can sell your product. Unfortunately, here is where a 'business mind' can be a bad thing. Most people believe that to have a successful business blog promoting a product, they have to stay strictly 'on the topic.' If all you're doing is shamelessly promoting your product, then who is going to want to read the latest thing you're writing about? Instead, you need to give some useful or entertaining information away __________ so that people have a reason to keep coming back. Only by doing this can you create an interested audience that you will then be able to sell to. So, the best way to be successful with a business blog is to write about things that your audience will be interested in.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① for sale: 판매용으로 — 문맥과 반대
② for free ←정답: 사람들이 다시 올 이유를 갖도록 유용한 정보를 '무료로' 주어야 한다
③ in advance: 미리 — 문맥과 무관
④ at a price: 유료로 — 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 사람들이 계속 찾아오게 하려면 정보를 어떤 조건으로 주어야 하는지 파악하세요.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 재고가 없는 / 비공식적으로 / 주제에 맞게 / 시장에 나온
det.analysis:
① out of stock: 재고 없음 — 문맥과 무관
② off the record: 비공식적으로 — 문맥과 무관
③ on the topic ←정답: 대부분 사람은 성공적인 사업 블로그를 하려면 엄격하게 '주제에서 벗어나지 않아야' 한다고 믿는다
④ in the market: 시장에 나온 — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: 제품 홍보 블로그가 무엇에 엄격히 머물러야 한다고 사람들이 믿는지 파악하세요.
